text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Glengrove Avenue, between Danesbury Avenue and Marlee Avenue. Currently parking is allowed for up to three hours in this area. The proposed changes will address residents' concerns with nearby workers parking their vehicle for the entire day.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Glengrove Avenue, between Danesbury Avenue and Marlee Avenue.
